name: Researcher → Reviewer Handoff (initial pass)
description: When the initial researcher loop completes successfully (the user-initiated default-role spawn), spawn a research-reviewer to evaluate the artifact via reviewer-as-enumerator. Mirrors R1's rule 01; reused verbatim into the R3.2.2 rules dir from R2.5 so the R3.2.2 e2e config can scope to a single rules path. R3.2.2 of the ADR-031 phasing.

on_enter.subject: agent.task.research-review
on_enter.prompt: Evaluate the prior researcher loop's submission. Researcher loop id: $entity.id. Call read_loop_result with that loop id to fetch the artifact, apply the active checklist, then call decide(action="approved") if all required items are present, or decide(action="insufficient", reason="<bullet list of gaps>") otherwise. If the artifact's open_gaps names a corpus that is not indexed, list 'recommend add_source_repo for <repo>' in your insufficient reason.

metadata.track_for_r33: Rule fires on outcome=success regardless of whether emit_research_artifact was called by the researcher — the persona instructs the call (researcher/30-emit-artifact.md) but a real LLM might skip it. Chain still works for the persona-swap, but the typed-payload audit trail silently degrades. R3.3 should evaluate adding a triple-presence condition (e.g., {field: research.artifact.revision, operator: exists}) once the framework's expression engine support is confirmed in beta.27.
